# entrepot_repository (Data Source)

Looks up a repository by name. The attributes mirror the `entrepot_repository` resource (without the write-only proxy password), plus the actions the provider's credentials may perform on it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "entrepot_repository" "npm" {
  name = "npm"
}

# e.g. for an .npmrc template
output "npm_registry_url" {
  value = data.entrepot_repository.npm.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Repository name.

### Read-Only

- `anonymous_read` (Boolean) Whether unauthenticated reads are allowed.
- `blob_store` (String) Blob store holding the repository's content.
- `cleanup_policies` (List of String) Names of the cleanup policies applied (null when none).
- `description` (String) Description.
- `docker` (Attributes) Docker settings (null when not set). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--docker))
- `format` (String) Repository format (`raw`, `pypi`, `npm`, `docker`, `apt`, `yum`, `helm`).
- `group` (Attributes) Group settings (null unless `kind = "group"`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group))
- `hosted` (Attributes) Hosted settings (null unless `kind = "hosted"`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hosted))
- `id` (String) Same as `name`.
- `kind` (String) `hosted`, `proxy` or `group`.
- `online` (Boolean) Whether the repository is online (offline proxies serve only cached content).
- `permissions` (List of String) Actions the provider's credentials may perform on the repository (`read`, `write`, `delete`, `admin`).
- `proxy` (Attributes) Proxy settings (null unless `kind = "proxy"`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy))
- `scan` (Attributes) Vulnerability scanning policy (null when not configured). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scan))
- `url` (String) URL to configure package clients with.

<a id="nestedatt--docker"></a>
### Nested Schema for `docker`

Read-Only:

- `host` (String) Hostname on which the registry API is this repository (images without the repository prefix).


<a id="nestedatt--group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group`

Read-Only:

- `members` (List of String) Member repositories, searched in order.
- `prefer_hosted` (Boolean) Whether hosted members win over proxy members for a package name.


<a id="nestedatt--hosted"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hosted`

Read-Only:

- `allow_redeploy` (Boolean) Whether existing versions (Docker: tags) may be overwritten.
- `apt` (Attributes) Apt distributions published. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hosted--apt))
- `yum` (Attributes) Yum repodata settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hosted--yum))

<a id="nestedatt--hosted--apt"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hosted.apt`

Read-Only:

- `distributions` (Attributes List) Distributions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hosted--apt--distributions))

<a id="nestedatt--hosted--apt--distributions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hosted.apt.distributions`

Read-Only:

- `architectures` (List of String) Architectures.
- `components` (List of String) Components.
- `label` (String) Release file Label.
- `name` (String) Distribution name, e.g. `bookworm`.
- `origin` (String) Release file Origin.



<a id="nestedatt--hosted--yum"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hosted.yum`

Read-Only:

- `repodata_depth` (Number) Directory depth at which repodata is generated.



<a id="nestedatt--proxy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy`

Read-Only:

- `content_ttl_seconds` (Number) Cache time for artifacts (null: never expire).
- `metadata_ttl_seconds` (Number) Cache time for indexes/metadata (null: server default).
- `negative_cache_ttl_seconds` (Number) Cache time for upstream 404s (null: server default).
- `remote_url` (String) Upstream URL.
- `routing_rule` (String) Name of the routing rule restricting what is fetched upstream.
- `username` (String) Upstream username.


<a id="nestedatt--scan"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scan`

Read-Only:

- `block_on_error` (Boolean) Whether downloads of components whose latest scan failed are blocked (fail closed).
- `block_until_scanned` (Boolean) Whether downloads are blocked until the first scan completes.
- `distro` (String) Apt/Yum distribution used for vulnerability matching.
- `hold_seconds` (Number) How long a download of content still being scanned waits for the verdict (0: refused at once).
- `mode` (String) `off`, `warn` or `quarantine`.
- `on_proxy_fetch` (Boolean) Whether components cached by a proxy are scanned.
- `on_upload` (Boolean) Whether uploads are scanned.
- `scanners` (List of String) Names of the scanners run.
- `severity_threshold` (String) Lowest severity that quarantines.
